en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a mid‑20th‑century cargo or tanker ship at sea, viewed from the port side. The vessel has multiple masts, cargo booms, and a prominent central superstructure with a dark funnel. The sea is relatively calm and the sky is overcast and empty. The name "TEXAS" is painted on the bow and also faintly visible amidships. No other clear landmarks or coastline are visible.
